summary: Pose questions about the classroom and gather data to answer them by sorting and counting.
Pose questions about the classroom and gather data that can be shown in a picture or graph.
Estimate lengths in inches, feet, yards, centimeters, and meters (adds yards).
Pose a classroom question and gather whole-unit length measurements to answer it.
Read data shown with a one-unit scale and use it to answer questions; no category limit given.
Pose questions and collect measurement data to show in scaled picture or bar graphs (guidance keeps line plots).
Fluently add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers with flexible strategies and algorithms, not only the standard one.
Pose questions and plan how to collect fraction measurement data for a line plot.
Read line plots of fraction measurements with like denominators to answer questions.
Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers with flexible strategies and algorithms, not only the standard one.
Pose questions and plan how to collect fraction data to answer them with line plots.
Describe how numerical data in line plots or category data in bar graphs is spread, then answer questions.

# - 2021 Oregon Mathematics Standards Crosswalk to CCSS 2010, v5.2.10 (updated 9/4/2024):
# - K-12 Full Version with Guidance (guidance v5.2.10.3; per-standard "Common Core (CCSS) (2010)" field used as the official mapping):
# - Grade.Domain.ClusterLetter.Number, e.g. 3.GM.B.3. Numbers run on through a domain across clusters (K.GM.C.7, 2.GM.D.11).
# - No lettered sub-parts; CCSS sub-parts (e.g. 3.NF.A.3a-d, 3.MD.C.7a-d) are folded into the parent standard text.
# - NCC Numeric Reasoning: Counting and Cardinality (K only; CCSS K.CC)
# - NBT Numeric Reasoning: Base Ten Arithmetic (K-5)
# - GM  Geometric Reasoning and Measurement (K-5; merges CCSS G and the measurement half of MD)
# - DR  Data Reasoning (K-5; the data half of CCSS MD, reframed as statistical investigation: A = pose questions/collect data, B = analyze/interpret)
# - None outright. Every CCSS K-5 standard is mapped by ODE to a 2021 standard.
# - 5.G.B.3 (attributes inherited by subcategories) is merged into 5.GM.B.3 with 5.G.B.4 (crosswalk "Merge with 5.GM.B.3").
# - Thinned: CCSS 2.MD.D.9, 3.MD.B.4, 4.MD.B.4, 5.MD.B.2 line-plot specifics now sit mostly in guidance/boundaries, not in the standard text.
# - DR.A.1 "pose investigative questions and collect/consider data" at every grade; K, 1, 4, 5 marked [new content] by ODE.
# - Fluency standards (2.OA.B.2, 2.NBT.B.5, 3.OA.C.7, 3.NBT.A.2, 4.NBT.B.4, 5.NBT.B.5) say "accurate, efficient, and flexible strategies
#   and algorithms" instead of CCSS's "standard algorithm"; only 4.NBT.B.4 and 5.NBT.B.5 (where CCSS names the standard algorithm) marked edited.
